blocking_findings.problem: Focused lineage permits unverified parent bytes and invalid historical revision metadata. load() checks an expected digest only when truthy; the parent and inherited historical root are not required to contain valid whole-file SHA-256 values. A same-byte parent at another logical path is also accepted without anchoring the original immutable parent path.
blocking_findings.impact: A terminal focused PASS can lose its immutable parent/revision anchor, violating the governing Preflight lineage contract.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Require exact hashed-reference shapes and nonempty 64-hex digests before reading or comparing current/root/parent metadata, always verify parent digest over parsed descriptor bytes, and bind the parent to the immutable first Review logical path plus SHA rather than accepting an arbitrary equivalent path. Add negative regressions for all reproduced cases.

blocking_findings.problem: Project-relative parent Review evidence can escape the bound project through an intermediate directory symlink. _verified_parent resolves the logical parent first, then guards the resolved chain; it does not reject the original intermediate symlink.
